title: Character Sheet Editor fed a headless sheet: the chained Headless leg runs SAM3 again and eats the hair
description: Fabio 2026-10-11: input flowCharacterSheet_012 was itself a headless-leg output; Editor kept the grey oval, then the chain removed a head that was not there and SAM3 took hair (flowCharacterSheet_014). Breaks users on the 2.1 Editor.
